_comment_units: 11 units, each 'KAUHANYO YA N' + its title (Word numbers some titles 3.N automatically, others carry it typed) + a picture + a one-line sub-topic.
Unit banner KAUHANYO YA N (h1), then the unit title 3.N TITLE (h2, in the contents); Word numbers some titles 3.N itself, so the number is typed for all.
Each unit picture carries a caption line (3.N …, small italic under the photo in the manuscript; Word list numbering) - set as the picture caption.
Unit 10 is typed 'KAUHANYO 10' (no 'YA') - made like the rest. 'KAUHANYO YA 1' is lost on import (read as the end of the contents list) - put back with insertHead.

insertText.text: **Zwelopili:** Kuhula ni kuisa bupilo kapa musebezi kwapili.
**Tumelelano:** Kuzamaelela kwa likalulo za pulelo kuya ka libizo ni pupo ya puo.
**Tatubo:** Musebezi wa kulemuha zibo, buikoneli ni miinelo, ka bupaki.
**Pupo/Sibupeho:** Mukwa wo likalulo likopana kuli libupe linzwi, pulelo kapa taba.
**Muinelo:** Litaba ni mayemo moo linzwi kapa kezo liitusiswa.
**Linguli:** Lipulelo za sicaba zefitisa tuto kapa kelezo.
**Mashitanguti:** Lipulelo zetaluso yazona isafumanehi ka linzwi ni linzwi feela.
**Kanganisano:** Kuambolisana ka mihupulo yeleemela ni yehanyeza taba, ka mabaka ni bupaki.
**Bupaki:** Litaba kapa mitala yetusa kutatuba muhupulo.
**Buikalabelo:** Kuunga musebezi kapa mulatu wa likezo zahao.
